summary: Frontend-only regression and responsive testing completed on preview URL. Core dashboard, orders, conversations, products, analytics, settings, notifications, help, persistence, and reset flows were exercised end-to-end.

integration_issues.issue: Console error from Settings phone input pattern: `[0-9+() -]{8,22}` is rejected as invalid regex in browser (`Invalid character in character class`).
Console hydration/rendering error: invalid DOM nesting reported as `<span>` inside `<option>`.
Repeated Recharts warning on initial render (`width(-1) and height(-1) should be greater than 0`).

action_items: Fix phone input `pattern` syntax to a browser-valid regex and re-verify save flow has no console errors.
Fix invalid node rendering inside `<option>` in New Order product select to remove hydration/render warning.
Stabilize chart container sizing at mount to prevent Recharts negative width/height warning.
Re-run quick console clean test on Dashboard, Orders (New Order dialog), and Settings pages.
critical_code_review_comments: `Settings.jsx` uses a `pattern` value currently failing browser regex validation and triggers runtime error.
`Orders.jsx` product select options trigger invalid child warning; avoid non-text descendants under `<option>`.
Chart components mount before dimensions are ready in some transitions, causing noisy runtime warnings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: State was restored to pristine defaults by confirmed reset at end of testing. Main functional flows passed: KPI switch (7/30), CSV export content, approvals/stock update/complete, rejection path, orders filters/search/create validation, products CRUD+validation, conversations unread/read/send+persist, analytics period/metric switch, settings persistence and reset behavior, notifications deep-link, help dialog, responsive checks (1920x800, 390x844, 360x844) with no global horizontal overflow.
rca of the issue: RCA-1: Browser regex parser rejects `pattern` in Settings due character-class composition (hyphen placement) under modern regex mode, creating console runtime error on render/validation. RCA-2: The New Order select option rendering includes an injected span/content wrapper, violating HTML option content constraints and causing hydration/render warning. RCA-3: Recharts container occasionally measures as -1 at mount/responsive transitions, indicating chart mount before stable container dimensions.
